prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. DARKLIGHT: REQUIEM production pixel-art spritesheet. Draw exactly TWELVE NEW COMPLETE Fabius Réquiem NORMAL figures, THREE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, generous tall portrait RGBA canvas. Reference1 is the EXACT HUMAN-APPROVED normal walking art: preserve its identity, scale, long black coat with burgundy lining, silver neutral katana, black gloves/boots, silver belts/chains and natural short brown haircut. DO NOT change or regenerate reference1 itself. Reference2 is the authority for the NEW rear orientations, back of haircut, nape, rear coat details, anatomical right-hand katana and mature proportions. Reference3 is EYES ONLY dark-red iris #C40814/shadow#5A0000 when geometrically visible; do not copy red hair. These are reference images for new whole drawings, not anatomical cutouts.
FIRST SIX figures (rows1and2, read left-to-right) form WALK NORTHWEST, heading diagonally UP-LEFT45degrees. Show THREE-QUARTER BACKS: skull/back hair/nape, shoulders, torso, pelvis, knees, boots and coat point UP-LEFT together. Only ear/a slim side-jaw edge may show; NO forward-facing eyes, no face looking at camera, no twisted owl neck. The back of the coat and posterior shoulder line dominate. LAST SIX figures (rows3and4) form WALK NORTH, heading UP: TRUE FULL BACK VIEW, NO EYES OR FACE VISIBLE. Back of short brown layered hair, nape, rear coat seam/back belt, both posterior shoulders and boots visible. Draw real directions, no flat rotations or mirroring of asymmetric sword or chain.
For EACH direction draw a coherent SIX-PHASE in-place WALK matching the approved source cadence. Phase0 anatomicalLEFT foot forward along walking heading, RIGHT foot back/contact. Phase1 left leg supports, right knee bends and swings forward. Phase2 right foot passes beneath the hip. Phase3 anatomicalRIGHT foot forward along walking heading, LEFT foot back: visibly reversed stride from phase0. Phase4 right supports, left knee bends swinging forward. Phase5 left foot passes beneath hip back into phase0. Both legs must exchange roles; draw the opposite leading boot in phases0and3. Keep feet and separated coat tails legible enough to see the alternating steps. Natural opposed free-arm motion and restrained coat motion, no running/lunge/jump, no body-size change. Stable adult approved head/body proportion, constant height/build across12figures. Entire lowered silver curved katana stays held in anatomical RIGHT hand; in rear views this is the character's right, never swap sides. Show complete blade to its tip and natural occlusion of hilt/grip; left hand remains free. All head/body/hands/coat/boots/blade remain part of each whole figure.
Normal means NATURAL BROWN short hair with canonical volume/length unchanged, no red/violet/silver streaks, no transformation or aura. Clean warm peach skin, no red eye-smears or tinted skin. Black coat burgundy lining with small physical red stud/seam accents, no spikes/large crystals, neutral silver steel katana black/graphite hilt. Same approved mature anatomy and face identity from source, no enlarged baby head or age drift. Crisp square pixel clusters, deliberate dark outline and coherent lighting matching the approved image, no blur/painterly smoothing.
Each of12wholefigures entirely inside its own clear cell with generous transparent margin around hair, boots and entire blade tip. No overlaps, clipping, missing limbs/blades, captions, text, labels, grid, frames, checkerboard, gradient, floor, cast shadows or background. REAL TRANSPARENT RGBA. Draw new complete poses only; never assemble faces/limbs/weapons from parts. Deliver ONLY this NW/N walk sheet; retain the approved prior sheets unchanged.
